goal: Prevent fee-bumped transactions from receiving an older locktime than the transaction they replace
Stops an unnatural on-chain pattern that fingerprints Bitcoin Core fee-bumping activity
agreement: General agreement on preventing locktime backdating during fee bumps
Verified with local test runs and code review (molnard, nervana21)
Suggested moving the bounds check inside the anti-fee-sniping conditional (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because locktime backdating occurs on only an estimated two percent of fee-bumped transactions
Fixes a transaction privacy leak against wallet fingerprinting but is reasonably deferrable
